title: Failure Heatmap & Triage Playbook - Onboarding Evals (Week of 2026-03-17)
content:
Purpose:
This doc captures the week-of snapshot of onboarding evaluation failures, a compact failure heatmap, and a playbook for triage and short-term remediation. The goal is to reduce time-to-resolution for regressions discovered during model onboarding and to standardize the first 48 hours of response across applied-ml, runtime, and product owners.

Quick summary (top-line telemetry):
- Evaluation window: 2026-03-10 to 2026-03-16
- Prompt-set coverage: 184 promptsets run (avg 62 per model variant)
- Regression rate (new failures vs baseline): 4.7% absolute increase across onboarding models
- Median latency of failing traces: 420ms (no obvious runtime correlation)
- Top 3 failure buckets by occurrence: correctness hallucination (38%), format/structure mismatch (27%), truncation/early-stop (17%)

Failure heatmap (conceptual top-down):
Rows = prompt families (instruction, summarization, completion, instruction+tool), Columns = model variants (v1-int8, v1-fp16, v2-q4f16, fallback-ld). Cell intensity = failure rate for that prompt family/model variant.
- Observations: instruction prompts spike on v2-q4f16 for hallucination; fp16 has more format mismatches on structured-output promptsets; fallback-ld shows higher early-stop on long-context (>2048 tokens) prompts.

Representative failing promptsets and notes:
- PS-0149 (billing-summaries): consistent date hallucination when model is cold-started; reproduces locally with fixed seed. Suspect recent tokenizer merge change.
- PS-1034 (qa-open-domain): multi-hop chain-of-thoughts degrade on v2-q4f16; answers shorter and sometimes omit intermediate steps.
- PS-0782 (csv-generator): formatting tokens missing closing tabular fences on fp16 under heavy batching.

Triage playbook (first 48 hours):
1) Ingest and classify (0-2 hours):
   - Triage lead (oncall_applied_ml) pulls failing jobs from onboarding-runner and tags by promptset id + failure bucket.
   - Attach raw trace, model variant, commit hash, and sample inputs/outputs to JIRA ticket.
2) Quick repro (2-8 hours):
   - Reproduce with minimal harness: single-run, same model binary, same tokenizer, deterministic seeding. If repro fails, add environment notes and escalate to runtime team.
3) Root-cause hypothesis (8-18 hours):
   - Hypothesis checklist: tokenization, recent merge in model adapter, quantization profile mismatch, KV-cache boundary, prompt formatting changes, rollout flag.
   - Run narrow ablation: swap quantization variant, run unquantized FP16, test with previous model artifact.
4) Mitigation & short-term rollback (18-36 hours):
   - If regression correlates to a specific quantization profile, pin onboarding route to a compatible variant and notify infra to block rollout.
   - For tokenization regressions, deploy tokenizer patch to preprocessing pipeline and run smoke tests.
5) Long-term fix & verification (36-48 hours):
   - Owner opens PR with fix + unit tests targeted at the failing promptset. Add evaluation hook in onboarding CI to prevent regression recurring.

Action items this week (owners and ETA):
- Asha P: Create gated rollout policy for q4f16 variants on instruction-family promptsets. ETA 2026-03-22.
- Marcus L: Investigate tokenizer merge in commit 9b2c7f; reproduce PS-0149 locally and propose patch. ETA 2026-03-19.
- Priya N: Add PS-0782 as a blocking promptset in batching smoke tests; update CI matrix. ETA 2026-03-20.
- Liam O: Run cross-model heatmap export and add visual to Confluence page (artifact CONFLUENCE-APPLIEDML-582). ETA 2026-03-18.

Decision rules / when to escalate to runtime or infra:
- If repro fails in single-run local harness but succeeds in onboarding runner -> escalate to infra (probable environment/batching side-effect).
- If failure correlated with quantization variant swaps -> escalate to runtime and schedule temporary pin.
- If failure is semantic and persists across unquantized and quantized -> escalate to product/research for promptset remediation or model selection.

Short case note (PS-0149 walkthrough):
- Symptom: dates fabricated for invoices, present only on v2-q4f16 and on fp16 with large batch sizes.
- Quick repro: same tokenizer version v3.1 reproduces locally with seed=42.
- Hypothesis: recent tokenizer merges removed several date-normalization tokens; quantization accentuated low-probability tokens leading to hallucination.
- Mitigation: pinned onboarding to fp16 unmodified while tokenizer patch prepared.

Follow-ups and next check-in:
- Weekly sync triage on Thursday 10:30am PST; goal to close P1 regressions within 72 hours and P2 within 2 weeks.
- Add automated Canary run for instruction-family promptsets against any new quantization profiles (owner: eng-serving-runtime).

Notes / open questions:
- Can we add stable token normalization tests to tokenizer unit suite? (Priya to propose)
- Need clearer SLA for onboarding regressions: propose 72-hour P1 target and 2-week P2 target.

Appendix (quick commands):
- Local repro: onboarding-harness --model=artifact-<sha> --promptset=PS-0149 --seed=42 --quant=q4f16
- Export heatmap: scripts/heatmap_export.py --window=7 --groups=prompt_family,variant

If anything is unclear or you need a specific failing sample attached, ping me in #applied-ml-triage with the promptset id and I will paste the raw traces.
